Meltio Technology Powers HORKOS’s New NX70 DUO Hybrid Manufacturing Solution in Japan

, a Spanish developer of wire laser metal deposition technology, today announced the launch of the NX70 DUO version AM, a twin-head non-bed machining center combining metal additive manufacturing and high-precision cutting in a single machine.

Meltio technology uses welding wire as the metal feedstock and laser energy to deposit material precisely where it is needed. This makes it possible to combine additive and subtractive processes for applications including complex part production, repair, remanufacturing, and prototyping.

“This purpose-built hybrid machine directly addresses the most pressing challenges in modern manufacturing—including severe labor shortages, floor-space constraints, and environmental impact—by delivering an uncompromising, highly automated solution. We look forward to demonstrating its unique capabilities to the global industry at JIMTOF 2026.”

The NX70 DUO version AM enables a two-stage manufacturing process in which additive and subtractive operations can be alternated as required. This is particularly relevant for complex components such as closed impellers, where conventional machining can be challenging due to limited tool access.

By consolidating multiple manufacturing stages into a single machine, the solution can reduce the need to transfer components between different systems while supporting greater manufacturing flexibility. Its potential applications extend across industries including aerospace, defense, energy, and heavy industry.

Visitors will be able to view the dry-run operation of the NX70 DUO version AM along with video demonstrations of actual printing, and explore how Meltio Wire Laser Metal Deposition and HORKOS precision machining can be combined within a single manufacturing environment.
